title: Flux 3 Keyframes to Video Draft
description: FLUX.3 is Black Forest Labs' frontier audio/video model. Generate fast, low-cost draft previews pinned to your keyframe images, with a reusable draft cache for full-quality enhancement.

pricing.text: Your request will be charged at 0.06 $ per second of generated draft video (720p).

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The text prompt describing the draft video.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.tooltip: Aspect ratio of the generated draft. `auto` lets the model choose.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.tooltip: Draft duration in whole seconds from 5 through 20. An explicit duration is required to validate keyframe positions.

inputs.name: generate_audio
inputs.tooltip: Whether to generate audio for the draft video.

inputs.name: safety_tolerance
inputs.tooltip: The safety tolerance level for the generated video. 0 is the strictest and 4 is the most permissive.

inputs.name: keyframes
inputs.tooltip: Keyframe images pinned to frame positions in the generated draft. Up to 10 keyframes with unique `frame_index` values. JSON. Required.
